title: XamlGen Input Document
description: Input document for the XAML generator. Two mutually exclusive modes: 'workflows' (full-file, one .xaml per entry) or 'root' (fragment, single unwrapped element).

expressionLanguage.description: Target expression language for all argument values in this document. Derived from project.json design.expressionLanguage. Determines which WF expression wrapper is emitted (VisualBasicValue<T> vs CSharpValue<T>).

workflows.description: Full-file mode. Each entry produces one complete XAML document. Must not be present together with 'root'.

root.description: Fragment mode. Produces a single unwrapped XML element or tree. Must not be present together with 'workflows'.

WorkflowEntry.description: A named workflow. 'name' maps to x:Class in the generated XAML file.

name.description: Workflow name. Used as the x:Class attribute value in the generated XAML file.

ActivityNode.description: A single activity. May be a leaf or a scope-container when slots are present.

arguments.description: Argument values keyed by CLR property name (member.name in activity-catalog). Values are expression strings in the document's expressionLanguage. The generator does not parse or validate expression syntax — values are passed through to the WF expression activity.

slots.description: Named child positions keyed by CLR property name of members with memberKind 'child' in the activity-catalog. Each value is a nested AST node.

SequenceNode.description: An ordered container of child nodes.

children.description: Ordered list of child AST nodes.
